verification: Source audit of page scripts/templates, route registrations, controller read/write paths and selected shared components/services. No live DB queries, browser requests, mutations, builds or application edits. Behavior means wired in source, not a completed live interaction.

classifications.wired_read: Live data or generated measurement is displayed; no citizen write is expected on this page.
classifications.wired_action: A control reaches a registered endpoint with a backing controller/service.
classifications.partial_action: Useful live reads/actions exist but specific promised actions are unavailable on this surface.
classifications.developer_fixture: Synthetic component harness, not live world data.
classifications.resolver: A directory or overview routes the player into a specific place or workflow.

findings.finding: Term Sync materializes every active legislature and then performs separate timer, successor-election and settings work per row. The UI renders one card per legislature. On a populated world this is an unbounded page and N+1 query path.
findings.recommendation: Require a place or bounded page/search input. Reuse scoped schedule data; do not load this route for exploratory QA on the live world.

findings.finding: Building the world recomputes global counts and joins for each snapshot and polls every two seconds. The adopted-map queries hard-code type_a_seats > 9 instead of obtaining the configured district ceiling.
findings.recommendation: Move heavy totals to bounded resumable snapshot production, serve measured freshness, and derive threshold from active settings. No query/load testing was attempted.

findings.finding: Amendments reads setting values from a root jurisdiction but latest enacting changes are selected across all jurisdictions, then reduced by setting_key. A child setting change can therefore provide the enacting metadata for an unrelated root value.
findings.recommendation: Scope values and provenance to the same jurisdiction; bound latest-change retrieval instead of loading every change.

findings.finding: Atlas explicitly sets optIn.available=false and optIn.url=null. A visible privacy/map participation narrative therefore cannot end in the advertised action.
findings.recommendation: Remove unavailable CTA from core demo or implement the consent-backed preference separately. World observation remains useful.

findings.finding: Between governments is a live border-settlement report but has no proposal/vote/detail action. Its Stepper always marks deliberation done and referendum active, independent of actual settlement rows or empty state.
findings.recommendation: Label static process diagram clearly, derive live progression from a selected case, and link to the actual participatory workflow before featuring it as playable.

findings.finding: Union page posts only kind=formation, while its controller accepts formation/join/exit and page text explains join/exit. The readouts lack a direct new-proposal continuation into the relevant chamber.
findings.recommendation: For initial demo, contextualize as advanced formation. Later complete join/exit controls and explicit chamber/result links.

findings.finding: Restoration controller includes review_case_id but the event table has no corresponding case link. Source service methods exist for declaration/confirmation/tier advancement, while the page is a standing drill and status read.
findings.recommendation: Keep advanced reference until a bounded training scenario connects evidence, judicial finding and rebuilding elections.

findings.finding: Public Records has a bounded record list but also loads the full legislature selector and runs multiple global counts; page-size alone does not bound all controller work.
findings.recommendation: Use current place and searchable choices, plus precomputed totals where needed.

findings.finding: Coverage/CoverageOps and four Dev kits are genuine developer instruments. Accessibility and ConstitutionalQuestions are reference documents. Treating all as equal features exaggerates the apparent number of things a player must learn.
findings.recommendation: Keep developer tools, public reference and player tasks as separate navigation layers.

demo_mode_verification.status: Implemented in source; live instance classification, applied trigger migration and behavior not verified.

implemented.detail: DemoMode::active requires instance_class=scale_demo and cga.demo_session_capture. InstanceClass fails closed to production if class resolution fails.

ConstitutionalEngine opens an HTTP demo session, bypasses engine role/training refusals except system-only forms, sets a transaction-local capture setting around the handler, and records _demo metadata.

Capture migration installs triggers. Logout calls endCurrent; expired sessions are checked every five minutes. Reversal records skipped writes and one demo.session.voided audit entry. Identity, residency, education and audit/public-record tables are excluded.
cga.residency_instant sets threshold to zero. Civic ResidencyController immediately verifies a newly declared monitoring claim when its threshold is zero. This is code, not only a rubric choice.
DemoSessionVoidTest contains capture/reversal, engine role bypass, production isolation and expiry cases. These tests were inspected, not run.

boundaries.detail: Engine role bypass does not make every screen actionable. Union/dissolution controllers require an actual seat before calling the engine/service; UI controls also require door.seat.
Demo dock visibility uses sandbox/devBar/impersonation rather than DemoMode's scale_demo+capture gate. A demo box classification alone does not imply a visible demo dock.

Capture wraps ConstitutionalEngine handler transactions. Direct controller writes such as support reports and translation verification are outside that capture scope; do not promise all site activity disappears on logout.

UPDATE reversal restores every non-PK column from the before-image using only primary-key matching. It has no comparison against later writes by another active session. This deserves a two-user shared-record case before conference cleanup is trusted.
Capture triggers are installed over tables present at migration time. New civic tables need capture installation maintained as part of additive schema work.

demo_mode_verification.demo_milestone: Use a dedicated classified demo instance and test the actual attendee personas/routes, persistence while two sessions are active, logout/expiry reversal, skipped-write reporting and stable return state. Verify the beta's instant residency setting separately. No instance changes, logout, simulated actions or cleanup were triggered by this inventory.

primary: Inspect resulting public record or audit receipt
optional: World overview after its null-data issues are repaired
proposed_demo_scope.acceptance: Before declaring demoable, execute a small representative attendee journey with a known persona/place and verify every selected action's persisted result. This audit does not claim those live checks were completed.
